attachments.parsedText:
MNS — Brooklyn Rental Market Snapshot, July 2026

Headline stats:
- Average Brooklyn rent: $3,685/mo, +2.4% MoM
- Average studio: $2,640/mo | 1BR: $3,410/mo | 2BR: $4,520/mo
- Vacancy rate: 2.1%, tightest since 2023
- Williamsburg remains the priciest submarket; Bushwick the fastest-rising

This is an aggregate market report. No individual listings included.
